label: clonazepam 2 mg oral (Klonopin tablet), fasted, n=25 men
note: FDA ANDA 74-940 (Alphapharm) approval package PDF page 25, Table 1, Klonopin reference arm. Fasted healthy men, weight not reported. Assay and LLOQ redacted. The printed CV% column looks copied from ANDA 74-925 and was not used; the means reproduce the printed T/R ratios and the reported AUC. Dose-normalised AUC is about 13 % below the 1 mg study's.
